lines.text: Fill a whole month of hours in under a minute, straight from your attendance report.
Log in to the attendance portal. Open Request Lists, then Daily Attendance Report.
Pick the first and last day of the month, and tap Search.
Take screenshots from the top of the table down to the Total row. Overlapping is fine.
At the bottom, swipe the table sideways and take one more, so the app can read Sick Leave or Holiday too.
Now in the app: Count it day by day, Import, Upload screenshots, and pick them all. It's read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
The app checks itself against the report's own totals. Three ticks means every day was read right.
Missed punches are filled the way payroll does it, and Fridays, holidays and leave come straight from the report.
Tap Fill in. Your month is done, and saved to History.
That's it. Your report never leaves your phone.
